title: StockX Price Snapshot Daily Event Volume
dataSources: StockX market prices (`stockx:price`), GOAT listings (`goat:listing`), Alias sales (`alias:sale`), sneaker rotation logs (`sneaker:rotation`), and deadstock age checks (`deadstock:age`).
app: StockX price alerts, GOAT listing exports, Alias seller settlement logs, sneaker rotation wear trackers, and deadstock age audits ingested into Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=stockx:price
| bin _time span=1d
| stats count as events, dc(sku) as distinct_entities by _time
| sort - _time
description: Counts how many StockX price snapshot events land each day and how many distinct SKU values are represented.
value: Daily volume is the fastest way to spot a dead feed, a sudden burst, or a workflow that quietly changed.
implementation: Ingest StockX price snapshot records into `index=personal`; schedule daily and compare count and distinct SKU values against your normal baseline.
visualization: Column chart of daily event count with a line for distinct entities.
grandmaExplanation: It warns how much StockX price snapshot activity showed up each day so you can see if the feed went quiet or suddenly got busy.
